domain: display UART leftovers, brake/PAS, faults/protection, current/temp limits, end-of-image veneers
notes: 16 FUN_* bodies renamed here. Eight end-of-image veneers already matched their targets (EnableMotorPwmOutput, ReadHallSensorPortBits, ApplyHallSectorPwmPattern, LookupHallCommutationAngle, DivideUnsignedIntRemainder, ReadVadcResult700Channel7, ReadVadcResult700Channel0, ReadTempBankAdcResult0); plate comments document the targets. DisableMotorOutput@0x10009788 was skipped as instructed.

Decompiler params/locals renamed on every exclusive function (100%). Listing-only get_function_variables was empty for several leaf functions that have no stack frame; those count as 100% when there are no locals.

ReadTempBankAdcResult0 is used as the third Clarke input (phase C) in ProcessClarkePhaseCurrents. It may be a phase-current channel misnamed elsewhere, or a temp-bank ADC reused in the current reconstruction path.

candidateTunables.meaning: PAS/cadence stuck-high timeout. If P0.4 stays high longer than 2000 ticks, period saturates to the stopped value (4100).
PAS/cadence stopped timeout and saturated period. Low-time counter saturates here; also written as the period when a timeout fires.
Glitch filter: falling-edge period is only committed if high-time > 7 ticks.
Minimum foc-state+0x10 while torque slew is active. Raise/lower the assist floor during the slew window.
Torque-slew abort after sample index > 50; clears flag bit 4 and restores saved angle.
Upper clamp on PLL/electrical-rate cell in ProcessParkCurrentPiLoop. Asymmetric vs lower clamp -1024.
Lower clamp on the same PLL/electrical-rate cell.
Stall/lost-rotor: if Clarke mag^2 at sample-state+0x34 is below 20000, SVM equalizes PWM and may ResetFocStateVerifyChipId.
Same stall path if phase-balance counter (pll-state+2) >= 32000. Counter increments while |Ib-Ic|<16, max 64000.
Q15 weight for new mag^2 in complementary IIR (2768 + 30000 = 32768).
Q15 weight for previous mag^2 in the same IIR.
Written to a control cell on one FOC angle-cross transition (ProcessSvmPwmAndStallProtect). Same 400 appears as a torque-path threshold in UpdateTorqueSensorState.
If those two bits are set, flag 0x4000000 and DisableMotorOutput. Equivalent to a 12-bit field >= 1024 if the low 12 bits are an ADC result.
60 electrical degrees (65536/6) added to hall lookup. Not a rider speed/power knob.

functions.name: HandleHallSixStepCommutation
functions.summary: On CCU event at 0x50010040: walk 6-step table into CR, ack flags; on second flag read hall via veneers and store electrical angle + 0x1555.

immediates.meaning: 60 deg Q16 added to hall angle

functions.name: DisableMotorOnAdcOverrange
functions.summary: Trip: bits[11:10] of [0x50010080+0x20] nonzero => set 0x20002690 bit 26 and DisableMotorOutput.

functions.name: UpdatePasCadencePeriod
functions.summary: Poll PORT0.4, measure PAS pulse high/low, call ApplyWheelSpeedFade on falling edge, publish period to UART+6/+7 and ride-state+0x16.

functions.name: ResetFocStateVerifyChipId
functions.summary: Zero FOC integrators at 0x20002B34; infinite loop if SCU+8 bits[23:8] != 0xF1C0.

functions.name: FindSectorPeakFromAdc
functions.summary: IPD: (ADC+4)<<4 minus bias; track max across sectors 0-5.

functions.name: FindSectorPeakFromPhases
functions.summary: IPD alternate: abs(phase A/B/C) at 0x20002840, track peak sector.

functions.name: ProcessSixStepPositionDetect
functions.summary: Inject voltage into 3 PWM compares per sector, dwell, peak-pick, write sector angle (0/60/120/180/240/300 deg), then chip-id check.

functions.name: ProcessTorqueSensorRingAverage
functions.summary: 6-sample torque ring, MATH divide normalize, NVIC IRQ 25 mask around divide. Caller: UpdateTorqueSensorState.

functions.name: ProcessHallAngleFromTorque
functions.summary: Hall angle plus torque-magnitude band offsets; ramp; ProcessParkCurrentPiLoop.

functions.name: ProcessTorqueCurrentSlewLimit
functions.summary: Clamp foc+0x10 to min 300, slew offset by 1, timeout 50 samples.

functions.name: ProcessParkCurrentPiLoop
functions.summary: Park, dual PI, MATH DIV CON=0x62, PLL step deadband 64, clamp rate [-1024, 2400].

functions.name: ProcessClarkePhaseCurrents
functions.summary: Three ADC reads, Clarke, mag^2 IIR, PLL; subtract 90 deg.

functions.name: ProcessSvmPwmAndStallProtect
functions.summary: Stall if mag^2 < 20000 or balance count >= 32000; else sine SVM PWM.

functions.name: CalculatePllElectricalAngle
functions.summary: Sine-table PLL/observer PI on Clarke alpha/beta.

immediates.meaning: angle index into sine table DAT_10009744

functions.name: EnableMotorPwmOutput
functions.summary: Thumb veneer through ptr at 0x10009760.

functions.summary: Veneer; no locals.
